signal_and_outcome.entry: BTCUSDT spot open at 00:00 UTC on t+1
signal_and_outcome.exit: BTCUSDT spot open at 00:00 UTC on t+2
signal_and_outcome.late_2024_rule: signals whose t+1 or t+2 would require 2025 are not evaluable; no 2025 price may complete a Discovery outcome

inference.p_value: one-sided asymptotic normal tail for beta > 0

economics.profit_factor: sum positive net trade bps / absolute sum negative net trade bps
economics.year_consistency: >=3 of 4 calendar-year buckets have non-negative net mean expectancy; 2021 is Apr-Dec available sample

criterion_f_semantics.text_authority: No single calendar year contributes more than 60% of total positive gross PnL.
criterion_f_semantics.implementation: For each calendar year, compute that year's total aligned gross PnL across entered trades. Define positive annual gross contribution as max(0, annual gross PnL). Total positive gross PnL is the sum of those positive annual contributions. Criterion F is max positive annual contribution / total positive annual contributions <= 0.60. If total positive annual contribution is zero, criterion F fails.
criterion_f_semantics.reason_for_freeze: The authority separately requires annual contribution reporting and phrases criterion F as a calendar-year contribution cap. This implementation is frozen before real Discovery outcomes to prevent post-outcome reinterpretation.

economics.max_drawdown: diagnostic only on cumulative net log-return path

mve0_required_gates: B beta>0 and one-sided HAC p<=0.10
E >=3 of 4 calendar-year buckets non-negative net mean
F no calendar year >60% of total positive annual gross PnL contributions
